questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: Can you turn right at a red light after stopping and yielding?
questions.explanation: You can turn right at a red light unless a sign says you cannot. You must stop completely and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: At a crosswalk:

options.text: Construction workers must yield to you.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right-of-way at crossings. You must stop for pedestrians in a crosswalk, whether it is marked or not.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds with turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will be slippery when wet. Slow down.

questions.question: Is it illegal for people under 21 to drive with any alcohol or drugs in their system?
questions.explanation: It is illegal for drivers under 21 to have any trace of alcohol in their system while driving. If caught, their license will be suspended for three months.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right for construction.
The road ahead turns sharply at a steep angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply at a steep angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road changes direction sharply. Slow down and be ready for an abrupt turn.

questions.question: Can you use parking lights instead of headlights at night?
questions.explanation: You cannot drive at night using only parking lights. You must use your headlights when it is dark.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead. Be ready to change lanes.

questions.question: A pedestrian crosses the street after the "Don't Walk" signal starts flashing. They are in the middle of the street when your light turns green. You should:

options.text: Go if you have the right-of-way.
Go if the pedestrian is not in your lane.
Wait until the pedestrian crosses before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the pedestrian crosses before going.
questions.explanation: Even at a green light, let pedestrians finish crossing. Do not drive until they are safely across the street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like tractors and maintenance vehicles display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: How can you avoid losing traction on wet roads?
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed on wet roads to prevent hydroplaning and keep your tires in good condition. If you lose control, release the gas pedal, do not brake, keep the vehicle straight, and let it slow down naturally.

questions.question: What should you do before changing lanes or passing another vehicle?

options.text: Check your blind spots and mirrors.
Signal your intention before changing lanes.

questions.explanation: Always signal before moving left or right. Check your mirrors and turn your head to look at your blind spot before making any sideways movement.

questions.question: You must yield to a pedestrian with a white cane or guide dog:

options.text: Only when the guide dog is leading the person across the street.
Only if a crossing guard is present.

questions.explanation: Always give the right-of-way to pedestrians who use guide dogs or white canes, whether or not the cane has a red tip.

questions.question: What should you do when another vehicle is passing you?
questions.explanation: When being passed, do not speed up. Maintain your speed so the other vehicle can pass safely and merge back into your lane.

questions.question: A minor who receives court supervision for a traffic violation must appear in court with a parent or legal guardian and attend traffic safety school.
questions.explanation: A driver under 18 who gets court supervision for a traffic violation must go to court with a parent or legal guardian and attend traffic safety school.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn is allowed here.
You can turn left only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn is allowed here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is coming up.

questions.question: The three-second rule helps you find a safe following distance.
questions.explanation: Use the three-second rule to keep a safe distance between your vehicle and the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings are warnings. This sign tells drivers to watch for a side road crossing ahead.

questions.question: Most rear-end collisions happen because the back vehicle is following too close.
questions.explanation: Following too close behind another vehicle causes most rear-end crashes.

questions.question: At dawn, dusk, rain, or snow, it is hard to see other cars and be seen. How can you let other drivers know you are there?
questions.explanation: Use your headlights whenever you cannot see other vehicles clearly or when other drivers cannot see you. Always use low beam headlights when you need to use your windshield wipers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: When you approach a railroad crossing with no warning signals (like flashing lights or gates), should you slow down, look, and listen?
questions.explanation: If a railroad crossing has no warning devices or only a crossbuck sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for a train. Only cross the tracks when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns that road conditions can cause you to lose control. Slow down on wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers about traffic laws. You must obey it. When posted, turning right is not allowed.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle, should you wait until you can see the entire car in your rearview mirror before moving back to the right lane?
questions.explanation: After passing, do not return to your original lane until the entire vehicle you passed is visible in your rearview mirror.

questions.question: When should you adjust your rearview and side mirrors?

options.text: Whenever you need to use them.
Before you get into the car.

questions.explanation: Adjust your seat, mirrors, and safety belt before you start moving. Do not adjust mirrors while driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a curve ahead or a road that gets narrower. You may see this sign on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: Your car's horn must be heard from 200 feet away.
questions.explanation: All vehicles must have a horn that can be heard from 200 feet away. Sirens, whistles, and bells are only for authorized emergency vehicles.
